descriptions.job-06dinfw:
Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Field Manager, CXQC, Principal to support the testing, verification, and turnover of critical infrastructure systems across our data center and mission-critical facility portfolio. This is a hands-on, field-oriented role responsible for executing commissioning programs from pre-functional testing through integrated system verification. The role is project-based, which means assignment locations will vary — candidates must be comfortable with travel and potential relocation to support active project sites across our growing footprint.

Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:

  • Execute pre-functional, functional, and integrated system commissioning activities across mechanical, electrical, and controls systems
  • Support startup and commissioning of critical infrastructure including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, PDUs, CRAC/CRAH units, chillers, and BMS/EPMS platforms
  • Document commissioning activities, test results, deficiencies, and resolutions in accordance with project commissioning plans
  • Coordinate closely with general contractors, subcontractors, equipment vendors, and the owner's engineering team to sequence and execute commissioning activities
  • Conduct site observations to verify installations are complete and compliant with design drawings and specifications prior to testing
  • Identify field deficiencies and work with the project team to drive timely resolution before milestone dates
  • Support and ensure readiness for operational turnover
  • Maintain accurate, detailed commissioning records including test reports, punch lists, and equipment start-up logs
  • Enforce safety protocols and ensure compliance with site-specific safety plans and OSHA standards during all commissioning activities
  • Communicate daily progress, issues, and schedule risks to the appropriate project stakeholders

ABOUT YOU

  • 2–5 years of hands-on experience in commissioning, startup, or field engineering within data centers, mission-critical facilities, or large-scale infrastructure projects
  • Working knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and controls systems common to mission-critical environments (UPS, generators, switchgear, cooling, BMS/EPMS)
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, single-line diagrams, and equipment submittals
  • Strong understanding of commissioning documentation requirements including test scripts, punch lists, and turnover packages
  • Experience coordinating with multiple trades and subcontractors on active construction sites
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, milestone-driven project environments with shifting priorities
  • Detail-oriented with strong written and verbal communication skills — able to produce clear field reports and communicate issues effectively to project stakeholder
  • Willingness and ability to travel to project sites; relocation may be required based on project assignment
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification preferred
  • Experience with mission-critical infrastructure commissioning (power, cooling, fiber, telecom) is a strong plus
  • Must possess and maintain a valid driver's license; active passport preferred for potential international project assignments

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is project-based and will be assigned to active data center construction and commissioning sites within Hut 8's portfolio. Assignment locations will vary and candidates should expect regular travel with the possibility of extended on-site presence or relocation depending on project needs. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

About the Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, FirstMark, Lightspeed, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the Team

Rain is organizing a national trust bank to bring regulated custody, reserve management, and stablecoin issuance inside the same group, and we need one person whose job is keeping that effort on schedule. You'll work with the proposed bank's CEO, our regulatory lead, outside advisors, and our product and people teams, and you'll own the program plan, the tracker, the calendar, and the document record for everything that has to happen before the bank opens.

This is a coordination role with a project-management backbone, reporting to our Head of Regulatory Strategy. You won't make legal, regulatory, hiring, or product decisions. You'll make sure they get made on time, that the people making them have what they need, and that nothing is lost, duplicated, or late. The role is new; you'll build its systems from day one.

What you’ll do

  • Own one program plan across every workstream: milestones, owners, dependencies, dates. Update it daily by checking with owners, not waiting for them.

  • Run the meeting cadence: weekly status and workstream check-ins, with agendas and materials sent ahead and action items sent the same day.

  • Log, file, and distribute regulator correspondence the day it arrives; break it into items with owners and internal due dates; assemble and format the responses; keep the record of what was sent and when.

  • Consolidate existing trackers and document lists into one library and one request log, then keep both current.

  • Run down documents from across the company: find who has it, task them with a date, follow up until it arrives, file it.

  • Enforce document standards on everything outbound: formatting, numbering, defined terms, cross-references, file names. Convert, assemble, or package documents when someone needs it done.

  • Coordinate recruiting logistics with HR and search firms: scheduling, feedback, offer paperwork, and the regulatory filings each hire requires.

  • Engage and schedule consultants for interview preparation and policy drafting; track deliverables.

  • Keep the inventory of policies, procedures, charters, and agreements that must be in place before opening, with owner, reviewer, and date for each.

  • Flag slippage before it happens, with the date and the reason.

You are likely to succeed if you have:

  • 3+ years coordinating multi-party projects with hard external deadlines, in a law firm, financial institution, regulator, consulting firm, or similar.

  • A record of running your own work without supervision. You send the reminders; you don't need them.

  • Advanced Word (styles, numbering, cross-references, tracked changes) and Excel; comfortable building a tracker others rely on.

  • Precise, brief written communication.

  • Demonstrated attention to detail. We'll ask for examples.

  • Discretion. The work is confidential and you'll sign an NDA before seeing any of it.

  • Authorization to work in the United States and ability to pass a background check.

Bonus attributes:

  • Experience supporting a bank regulatory filing, examination, or application.

  • Experience coordinating executive recruiting or board onboarding.

  • A legal, compliance, or executive operations coordinator background.

  • Familiarity with digital asset custody or payments.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Flexible time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

What you will be responsible for:

  • Functional Business Partnership & Requirements
    • Serve as the dedicated functional SME for Finance users, providing hands-on support during critical planning, forecasting, Annual Operating Plan (AOP), and month-end close cycles.
    • Partner directly with FP&A and Accounting stakeholders to translate complex business logic, driver-based planning methodologies, and reporting requirements into clear functional and technical designs.
    • Design and maintain end-to-end user workflows, Task Lists, navigation flows, and Smart View ad-hoc analysis grids to optimize user adoption and productivity.
  • Solution Design & EPM Configuration
    • Configure, enhance, and maintain Oracle Cloud EPM modules, primarily EPBCS & FCCS (experience with ARCS, TRCS, EDMCS, Narrative Reporting is a strong plus).
    • Manage metadata dimensions, hierarchies, member formulas, and substitution variables in alignment with evolving chart of accounts and corporate structures.
    • Build and maintain dynamic web forms, dashboards, and financial reports within EPM Financial Reporting / Narrative Reporting.
  • Technical Maintenance & Scripting
    • Maintain and monitor data integrations between Oracle Cloud EPM and source systems using Data Management / Data Exchange and EPM Automate.
    • Develop, test, and tune business rules, calculation scripts, and Groovy scripts to ensure rapid application performance and calculation integrity.
    • Manage application security, user provisioning, access groups, and dimension security filters.
  • Operational Excellence & User Enablement
    • Own day-to-day functional support: investigate variance issues, troubleshoot data load failures, and resolve calculation discrepancies independently.
    • Conduct regular training sessions, office hours, and create pragmatic documentation/user guides for finance end-users.
    • Participate in monthly Oracle Cloud EPM update testing and validation, assessing new features and ensuring business continuity.

How you will stand out:

  • Experience: Minimum of 7+ years of hands-on technical and functional experience implementing, configuring, and supporting Oracle EPM solutions (Hyperion Planning / Essbase and Oracle Cloud EPM).
  • Core Modules: Proven track record working with EPBCS/PBCS (Planning) and practical project or support experience with FCCS (Financial Consolidation and Close).
  • Data Integration Experience: Hands-on experience with EPM Data Management / Data Exchange, flat-file loading, mapping rules, and basic EPM Automate scripting.
  • Greenfield / Spreadsheet Transformation: Demonstrated track record of converting legacy Excel-based finance processes into structured, automated EPM applications.
  • Functional Acumen: Solid understanding of financial planning concepts (P&L, balance sheet, driver-based forecasting, OPEX/CAPEX) alongside core accounting principles (multi-currency translation, intercompany eliminations, retained earnings roll-forward).
  • Technical Breadth: High proficiency in Essbase calc scripts, Business Rules, Smart View reporting, dynamic web form design, and metadata hierarchy maintenance.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Management Information Systems (MIS), Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior dual-track career path: Experience working directly as a Financial/Accounting Analyst prior to specializing in EPM systems.
  • Exposure to regional APAC multi-GAAP consolidations, statutory reporting, or tax reporting.
  • Exposure to complementary Oracle modules (ARCS, EDMCS/DRM, TRCS, or Narrative Reporting).
  • Oracle Cloud EPM Certified Implementation Specialist credential.
  • Experience with Groovy scripting for advanced calculation optimization.
  • Fluency in Mandarin: Proficiency or fluency in Mandarin speaking is preferred to support regional stakeholders.

What you will experience working with us:

  • A culture that values authenticity and diversity of thoughts and backgrounds;
  • An inclusive and respectable environment with open workspaces and exciting start-up spirit;
  • Fast-growing company with the chance to network with industrial pioneers and enthusiasts;
  • Ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset industry;
  • Involvement in new projects, developing processes/systems;
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, fast growth, and learning opportunities;
  • Attractive welfare benefits and developmental opportunities such as training and mentoring.

--------------------------------------------------------------------

Bitdeer is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in accordance with country, state, and local laws. Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, colour, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.

About the Job

As a Director of Enterprise Sales, you’ll be joining the Revenue team at zerohash to support our continued expansion in the US and globally.

We are looking for a self-starting individual who has demonstrated success operating in a high-growth environment, with excellent communication skills, creating, and an ability to understand unique customer needs. You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, then developing and delivering strategic sales presentations, negotiating and closing deals. The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of crypto and fintech across payments and investments platforms, with the entrepreneurial spirit necessary for innovation in the crypto space. Although previous sales experience is beneficial, we are seeking an individual who grasps our product and is genuinely enthusiastic about exploring novel use cases and identifying potential new placements for zerohash.

This is a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Revenue Generation: Identify potential revenue opportunities, conduct pre-sales consultations, deliver customized presentations, and provide expert insights to create new revenue streams.
  • Effective Communication: Investigate and understand the business objectives, goals, and challenges of potential clients. Create persuasive presentations that articulate the value of zerohash's API solution in a way that resonates with prospective customers, assisting them in attaining their business objectives.
  • Exceed Performance Targets: Consistently outperform monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets and essential KPIs.
  • Data-Driven Reporting: Maintain precise, up-to-the-minute records in Salesforce.com, including meticulous activity logs and revenue pipelines.
  • Negotiation Mastery: Skillfully navigate complex negotiations with the appropriate level of leadership within a prospective company to successfully close high-value customer contracts.
  • Cross-Selling Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams to spot cross-selling possibilities.
  • Product Insights: Assist in setting product development priorities based on customer feedback and experiences.
  • Travel: Be prepared to travel up to 40% of the time.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated Experience: A track record of success in enterprise sales, preferably within the tech industry, or valuable experience in product development or pre-sales, with a strong record of meeting and exceeding performance targets.
  • Creative Pitching: Ability to leverage presentation tools such as Google Slides, Figma and prototyping tools such as Lucid Charts and Figma are a must have
  • Industry Knowledge: In-depth understanding of fintech and crypto, including emerging trends, technologies, and competitive landscapes.
  • Negotiation Skills: Strong negotiation skills with a demonstrated ability to close complex, high-value deals.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including the capacity to deliver compelling presentations and proposals.
  • Relationship Building: Proven ability to build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with clients at all levels.
  • Effective Deal Sourcing: Demonstrated ability to proactively identify and secure new opportunities, showcasing a 'hunter' mentality.

Benefits

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

descriptions.job-180o3qk:
Interested in working on cutting-edge blockchain technology and creating equitable access to the global financial system? Since 2014, the mission-driven team at the Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) has helped fuel the tremendous growth of the Stellar blockchain network, an open-source platform that operates at high-scale today. Developers and companies around the world build on it, and the SDF team is expanding to support the rapidly growing and changing Stellar ecosystem.

As Senior Content Marketing Manager, Institutional, you'll be SDF's institutional voice: the storyteller, educator, and persuader behind the content that influences banks, asset managers, and payment companies to build on Stellar. Most blockchains were built to route around regulated finance. Stellar was built to run it, and institutions are now testing that claim in production. You'll own the institutional content program, from case studies and solution briefs to recurring briefings and ABM content tracks, working alongside BD and Growth leaders, Product Marketing, Digital Strategy, and agency partners to move institutions from evaluation to decision.

In this role, you will:

  • Become the institutional voice behind the blockchain for regulated finance. Tell the story of finance moving onchain through case studies, primers, one-pagers, and web experiences that win over the full buying committee at issuers, asset managers, banks, and payment providers, from heads of digital assets and CFOs to risk, compliance, legal, and operations teams. Each asset maps to a buyer, a stage, and a specific solution like issuance, movement, or capital deployment.

  • Reduce friction at the middle and bottom of the funnel. Your enablement content moves institutions from evaluation to decision. Turn active deals and signed partners into case studies, account-specific collateral, objection handling, and follow-up material, and make sure every priority buyer, deal stage, and solution has the content it needs.

  • Be the keeper of the institutional narrative. Partner with Product Marketing, Social, Digital Strategy, and our agency partners so a single idea ships across every channel: a long-form piece, a newsletter, a LinkedIn post, a web page, and a short video cut.

  • Design and own full content motions. Build recurring programs, such as a briefing for institutional decision-makers or an ABM content track, from concept through distribution and measurement.

  • Support executive thought leadership. Produce the assets that extend SDF leadership's thought leadership: research and data for essays, charts and exhibits, and derivative cuts for newsletters, web, and social.

  • Fuel event-driven outreach. Build the invitation copy, outbound sequences, pre-event briefs, and account-specific one-pagers that bring the right partners and prospects to Meridian and institutional roundtables, then the follow-up material that keeps those conversations moving.

You have:

  • 7–10 years in content marketing, editorial, or research writing, with at least 3 years writing for institutional or enterprise B2B buyers in financial services, fintech, payments, or digital assets.

  • A portfolio of institutional-grade work: white papers, case studies, and explainers that an analyst or VP would pull into a recommendation for their CFO or head of digital assets.

  • Working fluency in tokenization, stablecoins, custody, settlement, and cross-border payments. You can explain what an anchor, a trustline, or a clawback does without reaching for jargon.

  • Experience partnering with BD, sales, or demand gen on ABM, nurture, and account growth.

  • A research instinct for proof. You find the evidence institutions trust, such as analyst research, industry benchmarks, and customer results, and build the story on it.

  • A habit of measuring what your content moves. You track BD usage and target-account engagement, and use what you learn to decide what to make next.

  • A strategist's view of distribution. You plan where each asset runs across paid, organic, owned, and partner channels before it's written, and work with our Digital Strategy team on paid execution.

  • Range across formats: long-form, newsletters, web copy, social, and briefs for designers and video producers.

  • Exceptional writing and editing. Your prose is declarative, specific, and proof-forward, with no hype.

  • Sound judgment on claims. You know the difference between what a technology enables and what a regulated institution is responsible for, and you write accordingly.

  • The ability to run many projects with many reviewers (product SMEs, legal, executives, and external partners) without losing quality or deadlines.

Bonus Points if:

  • You have written for or worked at a bank, asset manager, custodian, market infrastructure provider, or payments company.

  • You understand how institutions evaluate public blockchains, including multi-chain strategies.

  • You have worked with AI-assisted content workflows and know where they help and where an editor still has to decide.

  • You have built content programs that show up in AI search answers, not only in Google results.

We offer competitive pay with a base salary range for this position of $125,000 - $170,000 depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, we offer lumen-denominated grants along with the following perks and benefits:

USA Benefits/Perks:

  • Competitive health, dental & vision coverage with most plans covered at 100% for the employee + any dependents

  • Flexible time off + 15 company holidays including a company-wide holiday break

  • Generous paid parental leave for all parents, plus paid pregnancy disability leave for birthing parents

  • Gym reimbursement ($80 per month)

  • Life & ADD (up to $50K)

  • Short & Long term disability

  • 401K with 4% match

  • Health & Dependent Care FSA Accounts

  • Commuter benefits with $250/month employer contribution

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with monthly employer contribution

  • Family building benefits through Kindbody

  • Wellbeing benefits (One Medical, Rightway, Headspace)

  • L&D budget of $1,500/year

  • Daily lunch and snacks in office

  • Company retreats

About Stellar

Stellar is more than a blockchain. About HIFI

HIFI is a stablecoin infrastructure company building technology for the next-generation of financial products. We build tools for payments and tokenized money products across money movement, cards, and capital markets. Institutions and enterprises already use our platform and APIs to move billions of dollars in production environments around the world, and we are still early.

 

Founded in 2022, our organization is flat and our team is talent dense. We work in person at our office in Flatiron and are intentional about who we work with. We've raised $37 million from world-class investors, including a Series A led by Left Lane Capital.

 

About the Team

HIFI's engineering team builds the payments infrastructure that fintechs and financial institutions use to move money on stablecoin rails. The team owns the APIs, ledger, and on-chain systems behind every payment HIFI processes, and works closely with product and compliance to make sure that infrastructure is reliable, secure, and ready for regulated use. As HIFI's volume grows and more institutions build on our platform, this team will decide how stablecoin payments hold up at the scale and standard that traditional financial infrastructure is held to.

 

As a Security Engineer at HIFI you will help own the security of our company and the infrastructure behind our payments products day to day. You'll build HIFI's security program from the ground up, including identity and access management, endpoint security, and the cloud and network controls that protect our systems and data. This is a hands-on role with real ownership: you'll set the security roadmap based on risk, put core capabilities like monitoring, incident response, and secrets management in place, and write the policies that govern how HIFI handles access and information. You'll also be the person the team relies on to keep HIFI ready for audits and partner security reviews as we expand into more regulated markets.

 

What you will build

  • Design and implement the HIFI security roadmap from first principles to production, prioritizing by risk.

  • Lead threat modeling and hardening for our money movement systems.

  • Build core security capabilities, including monitoring and detection, incident response, secrets management, API security, and CI/CD hardening.

  • Own cloud and network security architecture, including segmentation, encryption, and least-privilege access.

  • Own endpoint and identity security across our devices and SaaS tools.

  • Reinforce engineering best practices around secure development and infrastructure.

  • Write and maintain information security policies and procedures.

  • Ensure HIFI meets information security compliance and audit expectations as we scale to more regulated markets.

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, compliance, and leadership to move fast without compromising safety.

 

You might be a fit if

  • 6+ years of experience in security engineering.

  • Deep, hands-on AWS and network security experience, with infrastructure managed in Terraform.

  • Experience owning security controls in a regulated environment, such as payments or financial services.

  • Strong web application and API security skills, including modern authentication and authorization.

  • Experience writing audit-ready policies and procedures.

  • Experience building security practices from the ground up in a fast-paced startup.

  • Comfort writing and debugging backend code, ideally JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, MDM, and database security, especially Postgres.

  • A builder's mindset: you ship practical fixes quickly and know when good enough is safe enough.

  • Interest in stablecoins and their potential to change how money moves around the world.

 

Why This Role Matters

HIFI moves billions of dollars for banks and fintechs, and keeping that money safe depends on the security of everything behind it, from our cloud infrastructure to the laptops our team works on. This is a chance to build HIFI's security program from its foundation and make safety a default part of how the company operates as it grows.

Must be within a commutable distance from our office and able to work in person most days of the week.
